00027 /**

00029  *

00032  * for the volume index where the file locates.

00035  * @param mode         IN:    Mode string used by fopen(3)
00036  * @param fpp         OUT:    Pointer to the File stream pointer returned by fopen(3)
00037  *
00038  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  
00039  *
00040  **/
00041 HxResult HxFileOpen(const char *path, const char *mode, FILE **fpp);

00045  *

00048  * for the volume index where the file locates.

00051  *
